question: On Passage — Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to “California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Ocean-Going Vessels At-Berth; Notice of Decision” (H J RES 210)
bill_title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Ocean-Going Vessels At-Berth; Notice of Decision".
plain_language: This resolution would cancel the Environmental Protection Agency decision that let California tighten emissions rules for ocean-going ships while they are docked. A Yea votes to cancel that decision. A Nay votes to leave it in place.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Diesel Emissions Reduction Act (H R 2140)
plain_language: This bill reauthorizes Environmental Protection Agency grants through fiscal year 2029 to replace old diesel engines or add pollution controls. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Local Communities & Bird Habitat Stewardship Act (H R 3276)
bill_title: Local Communities & Bird Habitat Stewardship Act of 2026
plain_language: This bill writes into law the Urban Bird Treaty program, including grants to help cities conserve birds. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act (H R 2860)
bill_title: Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025
plain_language: This bill revises and reauthorizes for seven years the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative and its Northwest Straits Advisory Commission. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Nationwide Consumer and Fuel Retailer Choice Act (H R 1346)
bill_title: To amend the Clean Air Act with respect to the ethanol waiver for Reid Vapor Pressure under that Act, and for other purposes.
plain_language: This bill amends the Clean Air Act to address the limitations on Reid Vapor Pressure (a measure of gasoline's volatility) that are placed on gasoline during the summer ozone season. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Recommit — Nationwide Consumer and Fuel Retailer Choice Act (H R 1346)
bill_title: To amend the Clean Air Act with respect to the ethanol waiver for Reid Vapor Pressure under that Act, and for other purposes.
plain_language: H.R. 1346 amends the Clean Air Act to address the limitations on Reid Vapor Pressure (a measure of gasoline's volatility) that are placed on gasoline during the summer ozone season. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

question: On Passage — FIRE Act (H R 6387)
plain_language: This bill modifies the definition of exceptional events under the Clean Air Act and requires the Environmental Protection Agency to revise its regulations regarding exceptional events or actions to mitigate wildfire risk. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — RED Tape Act (H R 6398)
plain_language: This bill removes the requirement under the Clean Air Act that the Environmental Protection Agency review and comment on newly authorized federal construction projects and other major federal agency actions that already require review under the National Environmental Policy Act and proposed federal regulations. question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — American Water Stewardship Act (H R 6422)
